description: This file defines the 'Login' feature within a C# ASP.NET Core project, encapsulating user login logic including validation, database access, password verification, and JWT token generation.

classes.name: Login.UserData
classes.description: Data transfer object representing user's email and password during login.

classes.name: Login.Command
classes.description: MediatR request representing the login command with user data.

classes.name: Login.CommandValidator
classes.description: Validates the login command ensuring email and password are provided.

classes.name: Login.Handler
classes.description: Handles the login request: validates user credentials, fetches user from database, generates JWT token, and returns user envelope.

methods.name: Handle
methods.description: Processes the login command, verifying user credentials and returning a user envelope with JWT token.
